page: Vultr voc-m-24c-192gb-2400s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled as a 2400 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. No GPU is present.

Benchmark results indicate strong compute and memory capabilities. The server achieves top-tier performance in stress-ng single-core CPU tests and PassMark memory scores. Multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU scores, and large-block memory read/write bandwidth are all rated as strong, placing in the top 25 percent. For specialized tasks, the processor supports AVX-512 vector and neural network instructions, contributing to top-tier text generation speeds on small language models and strong generation speeds on medium models.

Given its high memory density of 8.0 GB per vCPU and fast local NVMe storage, this server offers a highly resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads without the premium of specialized bare-metal hardware. It is well-suited for hosting large databases, in-memory caching layers, data processing pipelines, and medium-scale language model inference.
